nodes.name: Push to CRM

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify((() => { const l = $('Preserve first values').item.json; return { source: (l.channel === 'facebook' ? 'facebook3' : 'instagram3'), campaign: 'hakeem-fb-ig', name: l.name, ig_username: l.ig_username, ig_user_id: l.ig_user_id, phone: l.phone_digits, destination: l.destination, travel_date: l.travel_date || '', travelers: '', email: '', status: l.status, notes: l.notes }; })()) }}

nodes.notes: source='faheem_fb_ig' so Faheem's leads are separable in the CRM. The other bots leave source unset and all land as 'instagram_in'.
